description: This file defines a Java interface named OrderNumberGenerator within the org.openmrs.api package. The interface is intended for classes that implement custom order number generation schemes in the OpenMRS system. It includes a single method getNewOrderNumber, which generates a new, unique order number based on the provided OrderContext.

classes.name: OrderNumberGenerator
classes.description: An interface for generating order numbers within the OpenMRS system. Implementers generate and return new order numbers, ensuring thread safety and uniqueness.

methods.name: getNewOrderNumber
methods.description: Generates and returns a new order number based on the provided OrderContext. Must be thread-safe and ensure the uniqueness of order numbers when called multiple times without saving orders.
